description: Source code for handling various types of reference table records, including encoding, decoding, comparison, and management of different record types such as ref, log, index, and object records.

classes.name: reftable_record
classes.description: Generic record structure with type and union for specific record data.

classes.name: reftable_ref_record
classes.description: Structure representing a reference record with refname, update index, and value type.

classes.name: reftable_log_record
classes.description: Structure representing a log record with reference name, update index, and value details.

classes.name: reftable_index_record
classes.description: Structure representing an index record with last key and offset.

classes.name: reftable_obj_record
classes.description: Structure representing an object record with hash prefix and offsets.

methods.name: get_var_int
methods.description: Reads a variable-length integer from input buffer.

methods.name: put_var_int
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer into variable-length format.

methods.name: reftable_is_block_type
methods.description: Checks if a block type is valid.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val1
methods.description: Returns val1 pointer based on value type.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_val2
methods.description: Returns val2 target value pointer based on value type.

methods.name: decode_string
methods.description: Decodes a string from buffer into reftable_buf.

methods.name: encode_string
methods.description: Encodes a string into a buffer.

methods.name: reftable_encode_key
methods.description: Encodes a key with prefix and suffix optimization.

methods.name: reftable_decode_keylen
methods.description: Decodes key length components from buffer.

methods.name: reftable_decode_key
methods.description: Decodes a key from buffer into last key buffer.

methods.name: reftable_record_key
methods.description: Retrieves the key of a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_encode
methods.description: Encodes a record into a buffer.

methods.name: reftable_record_copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from one record to another.

methods.name: reftable_record_val_type
methods.description: Returns the value type of a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_decode
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_release
methods.description: Releases resources held by a record.

methods.name: reftable_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a record is a deletion record.

methods.name: reftable_record_cmp
methods.description: Compares two records.

methods.name: reftable_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two ref records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_ref_record_compare_name
methods.description: Compares ref record names.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_compare_key
methods.description: Compares log record keys.

methods.name: reftable_log_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a log record is a deletion.
